title: Co-constructing sociotechnical AI governance: participatory system mapping using algorithm registers
abstract: arXiv:2608.12166v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Algorithm registers have been championed as a means of providing transparency on the use of algorithms in public services. Yet potential publics differ in their expectations of what should be made transparent and how, as well as in their interest in and ability to parse the information currently published in the registers. Moreover, it remains unclear how these instruments can represent the sociotechnical systems in which these algorithms are embedded, and how system-level transparency can facilitate accountability. In this paper, we ask, what do algorithm registers reveal (and occlude) about the sociotechnical systems governing algorithmic systems, and how can diverse stakeholder perspectives inform a more pluralistic system-theoretic safety analysis? translated_title: 共同构建社会技术性AI治理：利用算法注册表进行参与式系统映射
translated_abstract: 算法注册表被推崇为在公共服务中提供算法使用透明度的一种手段。然而，潜在公众对于应透明化什么内容以及如何透明化的期望各不相同，且他们对当前注册表中发布信息的兴趣和解析能力也存在差异。此外，这些工具如何代表算法所嵌入的社会技术系统，以及系统级透明度如何促进问责制，仍不清楚。在本文中，我们探讨：算法注册表揭示了（或掩盖了）关于治理算法系统的社会技术系统的哪些方面，以及多样化的利益相关者视角如何为更包容的系统理论安全分析提供信息？为此，我们通过对荷兰某城市市政算法注册表的案例研究，该案例涉及一个用于案例工作者评估公民福利资格决策支持工具，进行了深入探究。
tldr: 本文通过荷兰城市算法注册表的案例研究，揭示了算法注册表在社会技术系统透明度中的局限性，并提出利用参与式系统映射整合多元利益相关者视角，以增强系统级问责制和安全分析。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the limitations of algorithm registers in sociotechnical system transparency through a Dutch city case study, and proposes participatory system mapping to integrate diverse stakeholder perspectives for enhanced system-level accountability and safety analysis.
